source.version: Part 12 — Trichomes and Cannabinoid Biosynthesis — Batch 02
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-226–230 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 12 manuscript plus direct trichome microscopy and sampling literature, cannabis precursor and olivetolic-acid biochemistry, CBGA prenyltransferase studies, direct THCAS enzyme work, and modern cannabinoid oxidocyclase-locus genomics. Public wording separates density from chemical yield, precursor pools from pathway flux, CBGA branch-point status from the oversimplified 'mother of all cannabinoids' phrase, and THCAS sequence/marker evidence from functional enzyme activity and measured THCA concentration.
source.note: This batch moves Volume 12 from trichome anatomy into reproducible sampling and the first major cannabinoid-biosynthesis sequence: precursor supply, olivetolic acid, CBGA, and THCA synthase.
